notes.title: Alpha Tests Feedback
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/d8b2dfbe656af12f52c78e537f7aab3da62c15f8.jpg[/img]

Hello Pillagers!

I had received a lot of very important feedback that helped me to make this game better! After one day of Alpha Tests, your hours spent in the game:


[list]
[*] Enlarged a map. Now it's twice time bigger.
[*] Removed the dealer's system. You've been complaining that it's unuseful and it doesn't fit a survival type of the game. I've also remastered spawn points and now you're able to find every weapon on the ground.
[*] I've been working on the collisions system. Some of the glitches have been fixed. I know that it still needs more work and I will be trying to improve it in the next updates.
[*] Hunger & Dehydration affects on your health. When you're hungry or thirsty you lose your HP points.
[*] I've added new buildings.
[/list]


Thank you a lot!

notes.title: Pillage Devblog 1
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/120418fdc68d477e90eadbb052e6ecd9711e11ca.jpg[/img]
[h1]Release: Steam in Summer 2018[/h1]

The huge Garbage Dump, full of old containers, trashes and valuable things(if you find them) and of course the looters - your enemies. You've entered when the gate was open..., but you can't get out now. You know that you're not alone there. Did you hear steps? This Garbage Dump is full of looters who think that all things belong to them.

There are no bots, there is no AI. Enemies are other players. Fight or hide! Rush or wait! Protect your stuff or just give up! It's your decision.

Find valuable loot, take it, try to alive and sell your stuff to the masked men, who are trades! Where are them? Everywhere. Hey! You!!! The dealer can offer some good things to you, ohhh.. of course, if you've got cash.

What the game offers:

- Map size: about 5km²- 64 players on the server.
- About 5000 places to hide - Over 8000 Loot Points.
- The map is adapted to enlarge.
- If you log out from the server, your equipment will be saved.


[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/9e7ac5e6f066780c54d76d5b6d520ca454a2c408.png[/img]

The game is [h1]NOT[/h1] a Battle Royale type of a game.

1. If you log out from the server, your equipment will be saved.
2. There are no weapons like pistols and guns! You will be able to use weapons like Machete, Axe, Pickaxe etc.
3. The game hasn't got time limiters like rounds, areas. You've got about 5km² of the map and you can play there as long as you want.
4. There is fully randomized looting system, in the trashes you can find, a silver coin, machete or carrot.
5. There are NO Rounds or time-limiters. You play as long as you want.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/c4ef8bdf90240701fbef5602a8415b0bd844c487.jpg[/img]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/173a42ff141f18b1d1152db1221d4472e499ffca.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Devblog 12
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/7ed3531a2a5db5b6f50c036d4bf2ae1c54d5ba51.jpg[/img]

New polished models, lighting system, optimization & post-effects!

[h1]Models[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/68b7c2cc51a1beebbe3e4fd20577a36f5868870e.jpg[/img]

The remastered furniture looks more realistic and they suit the environment well! Although models have got more vertex, there are more FPS than before! Thanks to the optimized the rendering system that I’ve been working on last week.

[h1]Lighting[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/ecac5ee582c0677767cef35965c827d3fdca7d94.jpg[/img]

I’ve been pushing the lighting system even further than before. The first thing you will notice here is that instead of having just shadows, there are blending with gloss and other lights now. This makes the scene look more realistic and models are easy on the eyes, as well.

[h1]Optimization[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/3a5c0a79aeee39eed64772257fa48a02ef0a85eb.jpg[/img]

You know that if you want to run a good-looking game, you have to have a good hardware. But on the other hand, the developer should optimize the game as well as it is possible. I’ve done it! The new rendering system with Occlusion Culling reduced the count of vertex 15 times! Yes, 15 times! That “FPS Supply” let me add more polished objects, remaster lighting system and add new fantastic post-effects!

[h1]Post-effects[/h1]
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32004527/da9afda7bf5dca036997ce4ddfce83fcfc41adb0.jpg[/img]

The game without post-effects can’t be called realistic-looking! The screenshot with the bloom, depth of field don’t show all benefits of post-effects.
Just watch new videos with Motion Blur, Bloom and more…


https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=D5GGLBcbiNA&feature=youtu.be

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=uesgCD7yLfk&feature=youtu.be
